name: Stormbringer: Airing Out shortens incapacitate/disorient CC natively (#2789)
contract: Airing Out (705675) has three effects, all aura 232 SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_DURATION_MOD, all TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, all EffectBasePoints -21 + EffectDieSides 1 = -20(%): effect0 MiscValue 30 (MECHANIC_SAPPED), effect1 MiscValue 2 (MECHANIC_DISORIENTED), effect2 MiscValue 14 (MECHANIC_KNOCKOUT) -- covering both 'incapacitate' and 'disorient' mechanic families named in the tooltip (SharedDefines.h:1400-1439). aura 232 dispatches to AuraEffect::HandleNoImmediateEffect (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:63), a live, non-null handler implemented in Unit::ModSpellDuration (Unit.cpp:12193-12223): that function reads target->GetTotalAuraModifierByMiscValue(SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_DURATION_MOD, mechanic) for each mechanic bit of an incoming negative spell and shrinks its duration by that percentage before the aura lands -- the same generic mechanic-duration-reduction path used by many other classes' native CC-resistance talents, needing no module code. Since Airing Out's own aura amount is what that lookup reads, and the templar Finesse regression (templar-finesse.json) already establishes 'assert the passive's own aura_amount' as sufficient native proof for this exact aura type/parity-contract pattern, this scenario reads AuraEffect::GetAmount on the learned talent directly rather than staging a live incapacitate cast, which would need a stealth- or positional-gated caster (e.g. Sap) with no bearing on whether Airing Out's own modifier resolves correctly.
